title: Maple Soy Salmon Bowls
seoTitle: Maple Soy Salmon Bowls | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Glazed salmon over brown rice with edamame and shredded carrot
subtitle: Glazed salmon over brown rice with edamame and shredded carrot
description: Salmon fillets roast with maple-soy glaze, served over brown rice with shelled edamame, shredded carrot, and sliced scallions.

steps.title: Cook brown rice
steps.instruction: Simmer brown rice until tender and chewy, about 35–40 minutes. Fluff with fork so grains stay separate, not mashed or sticky.

steps.title: Mix maple soy glaze
steps.instruction: Whisk maple syrup, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger, and 1 tbsp sesame oil until combined and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Roast salmon
steps.instruction: Place salmon on parchment-lined pans. Brush half the glaze. Bake at 400°F 12–14 minutes, brush again, finish 2–4 minutes until 125–130°F at center.

steps.title: Warm edamame
steps.instruction: Steam or microwave edamame 2–3 minutes until bright green and heated through. Toss with pinch of salt and remaining sesame oil.

steps.title: Assemble bowls
steps.instruction: Flake or slice salmon over rice with edamame and carrot. Drizzle extra glaze, top with scallions and sesame seeds.

proTips: Do not overcook salmon—it keeps cooking on hot rice during assembly.
Use real maple syrup; pancake syrup burns faster and tastes flat.
Offer sriracha mayo for crews who want creamy heat.
tonightSpread: Seaweed salad from the store if available.
leftovers: Salmon flaked into a grain salad with extra edamame.
Cold salmon on greens with ginger dressing next shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Brain food after a long shift. Balanced macros in a bowl that looks as good as it tastes.
mealPrepNotes: Cook brown rice ahead—it takes longer than white. Mix glaze in advance. Station: Roast salmon on parchment for easy release and quick pan cleanup. Station: Keep edamame warm in a small baking dish separate from rice to avoid sogginess. Station: Glaze salmon twice—mid-cook and final 2 minutes—for shiny lacquered finish.
